purpose: Every exactly-known value on this target, in one file, so that any reimplementation -- in C, in Rust, by another instance, next month -- has a gate it must pass before any of its new numbers are believed. A rewrite that does not reproduce these is wrong, however fast it is.
provenance: PRIMARY-VERIFIED-LOCALLY. Every number here was produced by a run that COMPLETED on this machine; nothing aborted and nothing relayed is included. The three Woodall values are from the upstream reproduce.py control suite, 13/13 passing locally.

graph.note: antidistance dbar(a,b) = d(a, reverse(b)); the full antidistance matrix is 518400 entries and is identical to the one in board-finder/gap/v4/verify_level_counts.py

exact_level_counts.note: levels are 1-indexed and count k-ELEMENT prefixes surviving the node-keep predicate: staircase, prefix-minimality, and lex-minimality under the stabiliser of vertex 0. A reimplementation that canonicalises more strongly will NOT reproduce these, and must say so rather than be scored against them.

m5_thm7_none.meaning: every (5,7)-set has antisum >= 36, by a zero-survivor sweep

structural_identities.why: the two staircases are identical at k <= 5, and prefix-minimality and stabiliser lex-minimality are local conditions that never mention m, so levels 1-5 of the two trees are the same tree. Predicted before measurement, confirmed exact.
structural_identities.why_leaves_match: Theorem 7 may only remove interior nodes that cannot reach a survivor, so any implementation whose leaf count changes when the prune is toggled has a bug in the prune.

full_depth_ablation_at_m7.verdict: NET NEGATIVE. Any reimplementation should default it OFF, and at m=11 its scan is C(k-1,3) = 120 triples against 20 at m=7.

orbit_counts_independent_of_any_search.note: computed from CO_7 alone, so they do not depend on any node-keep predicate and are a second, independent check on a reimplementation's graph. Cumulative by antisum bound.

throughput_here.note: a reimplementation's speedup should be quoted against 141686 on this same machine, not against Woodall and not against a different host.

budget.P_43_A_as_registered: completes on one modern machine within 30 days
budget.scoring_rule: a sharded run is scored in CORE-HOURS against 2880, never in wall clock, because a run spread over many sessions is not one machine. Fixed before any (11,7) figure existed.

not_exact_do_not_gate_on_these.m11_estimate_basis: 65 of 6655827 level-5 subtrees sampled to completion; relative standard error 49 percent, subtree mean/median 253, so the honest interval is about an order of magnitude either way
not_exact_do_not_gate_on_these.m11_level_6_is_a_lower_bound_because: the depth-6 run aborted on its time cap; its levels 3,4,5 read 2098/79994/6448262 against the exact 2131/82512/6655827, and that disagreement is itself the proof of truncation
